stability_guardrail.rule: Any non-abstain estimated action below 80% bootstrap agreement is published as abstain.

interpretation: Offline observational recommendation by configuration cell. Every action must pass support, confidence and 80% bootstrap-stability guardrails. The observed upgrade remains an experimental candidate because its 62.4% stability does not pass the 80% publication rule.
limitations: All records in the same configuration cell receive the same recommendation.
Online Gatling validation remains future work.
The independent test was not accessed for rule selection or backtesting.
next_gate: Freeze the offline recommender and continue to economic evaluation; online Gatling validation remains future work.
